mapper.select: SELECT s.student_id FROM student s INNER JOIN tap_user u ON s.username = u.username WHERE u.username = #{username}

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT s.student_id) FROM tap_user u JOIN tap_user t ON u.classname = t.classname AND t.role = 'TEACHER' JOIN student s ON s.username = u.username WHERE t.username = #{teacherUsername} AND u.role = 'STUDENT'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM student WHERE class_name = #{className}

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT cm.student_id) FROM tap_user teacher_user JOIN teaching_class tc ON tc.teacher_id = teacher_user.id JOIN class_member cm ON cm.class_id = tc.id AND cm.member_status = 'ACTIVE' JOIN student_profile sp ON sp.id = cm.student_id AND sp.status <> 'DELETED' WHERE teacher_user.id = #{teacherId}

SELECT DISTINCT CASE WHEN sp.student_no REGEXP '^[1-9][0-9]*$' THEN CAST(sp.student_no AS SIGNED) ELSE CAST(sp.id AS SIGNED) END AS student_id FROM tap_user teacher_user JOIN teaching_class tc ON tc.teacher_id = teacher_user.id JOIN class_member cm ON cm.class_id = tc.id AND cm.member_status = 'ACTIVE' JOIN student_profile sp ON sp.id = cm.student_id AND sp.status <> 'DELETED' WHERE teacher_user.id = #{teacherId} ORDER BY student_id

SELECT CASE WHEN sp.student_no REGEXP '^[1-9][0-9]*$' THEN CAST(sp.student_no AS SIGNED) ELSE CAST(sp.id AS SIGNED) END AS student_id, tu.username AS username, NULL AS password, sp.real_name AS name, MIN(tc.name) AS class_name, MIN(sp.created_at) AS created_at FROM tap_user teacher_user JOIN teaching_class tc ON tc.teacher_id = teacher_user.id JOIN class_member cm ON cm.class_id = tc.id AND cm.member_status = 'ACTIVE' JOIN student_profile sp ON sp.id = cm.student_id AND sp.status <> 'DELETED' LEFT JOIN tap_user tu ON tu.id = sp.user_id WHERE teacher_user.id = #{teacherId} GROUP BY sp.id, sp.student_no, tu.username, sp.real_name ORDER BY student_id
mapper.update: UPDATE student SET username = #{username} WHERE student_id = #{studentId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO student (student_id, username, name, class_name) VALUES (#{studentId}, #{username}, #{name}, #{className})
